class.name: NNBTSucceeder
class.brief_description: Ticks its child node and always completes with [code]SUCCESS[/code] once the child finishes.
class.description:
The succeeder node ticks its first enabled child node. While the child returns [code]RUNNING[/code] the succeeder also returns [code]RUNNING[/code]. When the child returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code] the succeeder completes with [code]SUCCESS[/code].
This differs from [NNBTFixedResult], which reports its configured result immediately and regardless of the child. The succeeder waits for the child to finish and only then reports [code]SUCCESS[/code].
The succeeder must have exactly one enabled behaviour-tree child. With no enabled child it completes with [code]FAILURE[/code].
